name: Arch Package & Cache Manager
description: Queries installed packages, checks updates, cleans pacman cache safely, and manages Arch packages.

tools.name: list_installed_packages
tools.description: List installed Arch packages, optionally filtered by substring.

tools.name: search_packages
tools.description: Search available packages in Arch Linux sync repositories.

tools.name: check_system_updates
tools.description: Check pending package updates and inspect pacman package cache disk usage.

tools.name: clean_package_cache
tools.description: Safely prune old cached package versions via paccache keeping the latest 2 versions.

tools.name: install_package
tools.description: Install an Arch package via pacman (requires explicit confirmation).
